_meta.description: Curated AI model catalog — 25 production models across video, image, audio, video-to-audio. Per-second and per-image pricing matrix across platforms.
_meta.routing_rule: Use cheapest non-null platform. Prefer direct API (google_direct, elevenlabs_direct, openai_direct) when within 5% of cheapest aggregator.
_meta.rating_scale: 1-10 community consensus from Reddit, YouTube, Twitter. null = new or insufficient data.

subscription_notes.elevenlabs_direct: $5/mo Starter plan — 30,000 chars/month included. Overage or pure API: $0.30/1K chars
subscription_notes.google_direct: $20/mo Google One AI Premium (consumer). Veo/Imagen API billed separately via Google Cloud pay-per-use.

models.name: Hailuo v2.3

capabilities._note: Feature/capability parity across platforms for this model — added 2026-08-18 after a real gap: kie.ai wrapper was defaulted to for a job that needed transparent-background output, which its CLI schema does not expose. Price alone (see pricing.cheapest) is not sufficient for platform selection when a specific capability is required — check this block first, then price among platforms that support it.

openai_direct.note: Documented in OpenAI API reference. First real test attempted 2026-08-21 on Anomalous Wild Scene 05 (polarization diagram) — blocked by account state, not capability: direct OpenAI API returned 429 insufficient_quota / credit_balance_exhausted on every call. Fell back to kie.ai chroma-screen + Recraft matting (Step 3 method 2) for that beat. Capability itself still unconfirmed live — retest once the OpenAI account has credits.

kie_ai.note: kie-cli gpt_image_2 --help exposes no background/transparency parameter (only prompt, input_urls, aspect_ratio, resolution, callBackUrl) — confirmed 2026-08-18.

models.notes: Use for image editing passes on existing stills. Replaces Flux Pro (deprecated).

variants.notes: Flux Kontext resolution-tiered pricing not confirmed

models.name: Midjourney
models.input_output: text→image | image→image | style reference | omni reference

models.notes: Use when aesthetic quality is paramount. Available via kie.ai API wrapper.

variants.notes: WaveSpeed Midjourney higher-res pricing not confirmed

models.name: Suno V5
models.description: AI music generation from mood, genre, or lyric descriptions; full tracks, radio-quality output
models.notes: Primary background music for all video pipelines. Call via kie.ai Suno API.

models.name: ElevenLabs TTS
models.description: Industry-best TTS; natural voice, word-level timestamps for caption sync, multilingual
models.notes: Always use direct API — already paying $5/mo subscription. kie.ai is redundant markup.

variants.notes: ElevenLabs direct: free within $5/mo (30K chars); $0.30/1K overage

models.name: ElevenLabs Sound Effects
models.description: Generate custom sound effects from text descriptions; high quality, short-form audio
models.notes: Use direct API where possible. kie.ai available as backup.

variants.notes: ElevenLabs direct: included in $5/mo quota

models.name: ElevenLabs Video to Music
models.input_output: video or text prompt → music soundtrack
models.description: Generate AI music soundtracks matched to video mood, pacing, and visual content via ElevenLabs Music API

models.name: Topaz Upscale
models.description: Industry-standard AI upscaling; high-fidelity detail restoration, up to 20,000px output
models.notes: Removed from active catalog. Credit-based pricing not comparable. Use fal.ai endpoint when needed.

models.name: Recraft Remove Background
models.description: AI background removal; clean cutouts for compositing, thumbnails, and overlays
models.notes: Utility model — use when compositing images over video.

variants.notes: Pricing needs fetch from kie.ai

models.name: Mirelo SFX v1.6
models.description: Generates synchronized sound effects for any video; similar to MMAudio, frame-accurate sync
models.notes: Primary option for adding environment/SFX audio to existing video clips.

variants.notes: fal.ai billed in compute seconds (GPU time), not output time — not comparable

models.name: Kling Video-to-Audio
models.description: Kling-native audio generation from video; uses Kling's model understanding for accurate sync
models.notes: Best choice if clip was originally generated with Kling — same model family, tighter sync.

models.name: Sonilo v1.1
models.description: Analyzes video pacing, mood, and timing to generate a commercial-ready frame-synced music score
models.notes: Unique: generates music that matches your edit's pacing — not just generic background music.

variants.notes: Billed per second of output video

models.name: SAM Audio Visual Separate
models.description: Isolate any specific sound from a video using natural language — remove wind, isolate dialogue, extract music
models.notes: Utility: use when you need to surgically remove or isolate a specific sound from existing footage.
